advancement_outcomes.semantics: Advancement is blocked by unresolved evidence or integrity failure.
Valid governance evidence establishes scientific-performance failure.
Advancement has one or more explicit material limitations.
All nine criteria satisfy their prospective acceptance requirements.

criterion_states.semantics: Predeclared acceptance requirements are fully satisfied by complete, valid, traceable evidence.
Complete, valid, traceable evidence contains a material limitation, heterogeneity, or partially favorable and unfavorable evidence that prevents an unqualified PASS.
Complete and valid evidence violates a predeclared scientific or integrity requirement.
Required evidence, operational definitions, provenance, or evaluation information is missing, incomplete, non-traceable, or non-derivable.

non_retroactivity: This contract must not reinterpret, overwrite, reclassify, or otherwise modify Sprint 10.8.2.38 or any earlier sprint.
